items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training
Experience working in/competing for a collegiate athletics program.
Experience working in a customer service oriented position. Desire to pursue career in collegiate or professional sports related field.

Under the direction of the Director of Marketing, Ticketing and Strategy this internship is designed to expose the individual to all aspects of athletic ticket operations through the fulfillment of single game and season ticket orders, serving as a front line customer service representative for UC Davis Athletics, providing game day support for ticketed sports/events, assisting with financial reconciliations including monitoring the ticket office clearing account, and working closely with Team Aggie to provide ticketing/ parking/event support as needed.
Must be team oriented, organized, and a strong communicator.
Attention to detail and strong writing/editing skills. Strong interpersonal and customer service skills.
